chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAmr ibn Shumr, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from his father, from Aḥmad ibn al-Naḍr al-Khazzāz, from ʿAmr ibn Shumr.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: nisbah of Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: part of the narrator’s lineage name
key_terms.عَمْرِو بْنِ شَمِرٍ: the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from ʿAmr ibn Shumr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports in the book transmitted from ʿAmr ibn Shumr. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission through which the author received those narrations.
